info.name: Delta Warranty & Service API
info.description:
REST API of the Delta iERP Warranty & Service module (Solartive Techno Industries).

## Getting started
1. Import this collection and the environment file, pick the environment and set `baseUrl` and `password`.
2. Run **01 · Auth → Login** — the token is saved automatically. Administrators sign in with their Delta iERP user name and password.
3. Every other request sends `Authorization: Bearer {{token}}` (set on the collection).

## Conventions
- Almost every endpoint is **POST with a JSON body** (filters go in the body). Configuration masters use GET / POST / PUT / DELETE.
- Dates: ISO 8601 strings (e.g. `2026-11-03T00:00:00.000Z`). IDs are GUIDs.
- Success: `{ success: true, ... }`. Errors: `{ error: "message" }` with 400 (validation — show the message), 401 (token missing / expired → sign in again), 403 (no rights to that screen or record), 404, 409 (duplicate / linked record), 500.

## Rights
- **Screen rights** (`FormRights` from getUser): calling an API of a screen the user cannot open returns 403 `FORBIDDEN`.
- **Data rights**: lists are automatically limited — state / district rights, managers to their service centre, engineers to their own calls, dealers to their own sales, customers to their own pumps.

Variables such as `{{complaintId}}` are filled by test scripts on create requests, or set them yourself from list responses.

item.name: 01 · Auth
item.description:
Sign in once, the token is saved to {{token}} and sent as `Authorization: Bearer {{token}}` on every other request.

Who signs in how:
- **Administrators** — their Delta iERP account (SolarativeiERP `dbo.Users` with `IsAdmin = 1`): iERP user name + iERP password.
- **Everyone else** — accounts from User Management: staff user name, dealer code (dealers) or registered mobile number (customers).

request.description:
Returns `{ success, token, user }`. The token is valid for 7 days. The test script stores it in the `token` collection variable.

`user.Source` tells where the account lives: `IERP` (Delta iERP administrator → Role SUPER, IsAdmin true, full access) or `LOCAL` (User Management). iERP administrators are checked first; if the user name / password does not match one, the User Management account is used.

Errors: 400 missing fields · 401 wrong user name / password · 403 account deactivated (or iERP account disabled).

Returns the signed-in user with `Role`, `IsAdmin`, `FormRights` (comma-separated screen keys), `StateRights`, `DistrictRights`, `ServiceCenterId`.

`Source`: IERP | LOCAL. For iERP administrators this call re-checks the iERP — if their admin flag was removed or the account was disabled there, it returns **401** and the app must sign the user out.

Call this when the app starts: it also refreshes the session with the latest rights (new token in the `authToken` cookie for web; mobile keeps its Bearer token).

Screen keys: warranty.serials, warranty.register, warranty.active, warranty.verify, warranty.dealers, warranty.customers, service.complaints, service.reminders, service.visits, service.jobcards, service.approvals, service.replacements, service.reports, stock.availability, stock.ledger, masters.*, system.activity. Admin / SUPER see everything.
Clears the web cookie. Mobile apps should also discard the stored token.
KPI tiles, 6-month registrations vs calls, warranty position, calls by status, installations by dealer and the 'needs attention' list. Already limited to the user's state / district rights.

For DEALER and CUSTOMER logins only.

- DEALER → `{ dealer, kpis, installations }`
- CUSTOMER → `{ customer, products[{ ...installation, Parts[{ SerialNo, Category, ModelName, EndDate, State }], WarrantyStatus }], openCalls }`
- `linked: false` when the login is not linked to a dealer / customer record.
Grouped suggestions: serials, service calls, job cards, customers, dealers, replacements. Min 2 characters. Each item has `{ id, title, subtitle, url }` (url = web route).
Older summary counts used by the first dashboard version. Prefer `overview`.

One call for every dropdown: company, states, districts, productModels, projects, callTypes, faultMasters, serviceCenters, spares, labourMasters, approvalRules, engineers.

Note: districts repeat names in the ERP data — de-duplicate by name (case-insensitive) before showing a list.
Company details read from Delta iERP.
category: PUMP | MOTOR | CONTROLLER (optional).
Product models are normally synced from the ERP. Needs Company Profile rights.

item.name: 04 · Configuration masters
item.description:
One generic endpoint per master: `{{resource}}` = spares | labour | faults | call-types | projects | approval-rules | states | districts. (Service centers have their own endpoints below — they also write the iERP ledger.)

GET is open to every signed-in user; POST / PUT / DELETE need that master's screen right (e.g. masters.spares).

request.description: Returns `{ rows }`.
Body fields depend on the resource (see lib/config/masters.ts). Creating a spare also records its rate history.
A job card needs every active level whose MinAmount ≤ its total. A named ApproverUserId is the only person who may act at that level.

{
  "LevelNo": 1,
  "RoleName": "Service Manager",
  "ApproverUserId": null,
  "MinAmount": 0,
  "MaxAmount": null,
  "Description": "Every job card",
  "IsActive": true
}

request.description: Include the record id field (SpareId, LabourMasterId, FaultMasterId, CallTypeId, ProjectId, ApprovalRuleId, StateId, DistrictId).
Pass `?id=<record id>`. 409 when the record is used elsewhere — mark it inactive instead.
`{ centers }` with StateName, Engineers, OpenCalls and the iERP ledger: LgrId, LedgerCode (e.g. S0001), LedgerGroup. LedgerCode null = not yet in the iERP (created on the next save).

Blank ServiceCenterId = new. Required: ServiceCenterCode (unique), ServiceCenterName (unique), StateId. Mobile 10 digits starting 6-9, Pincode 6 digits, GSTIN 15 characters.
Same save also writes the Delta iERP (SolarativeiERP): dbo.Lgrs under ledger group "Service Center" (code S0001, S0002 …, Lgrs.ServiceCenter = 'Yes', DisableStatus = not active) and the address in dbo.LgrAddresses (Billing ADDRESS, state / district / GST type resolved). The ledger name = centre name and must be unique in the iERP.
No delete — send IsActive: false to switch a centre off. Needs the masters.service-centers screen right.
`{ engineers }` (role ENGINEER) with ServiceCenterName, StateRights, OpenCalls and the iERP ledger (LgrId, LedgerCode, LedgerGroup). Passwords are never returned.

Blank UserId = new engineer login (role ENGINEER, default engineer screens). Required: FirstName, Username (3-50 lowercase), ServiceCenterId, Password (new only, min 6; on edit blank keeps it).
Same save writes the iERP: dbo.Lgrs under ledger group "Service Engineers" (next code in the E series, Lgrs.FieldService = 'Yes', UnderLgrId = the service centre's ledger — the centre's ledger is created first if missing) and the address in dbo.LgrAddresses.
No delete — send IsActive: false. Needs the masters.service-engineers screen right.

item.name: 05 · Users & rights (admin)
item.description: Admin accounts only. Users with role ENGINEER are also iERP ledgers (Service Engineers group): add / update keep the ledger + LgrAddresses in step (ServiceCenterId required, optional Address), delete disables the ledger. The list returns Address, ServiceCenterName and LedgerCode. New engineers default to the prototype screens: warranty.search, service.complaints, service.visits, service.jobcards, stock.availability.

request.description: Includes StateRights, DistrictRights, FormRights, ServiceCenterId and IsErpUser (1 = Delta iERP administrator, created automatically on first sign-in; password managed in the iERP). Passwords are never returned.

Roles: SUPER | HO | MANAGER | ENGINEER | DEALER | CUSTOMER.

- StateRights: StateIds, empty = all states
- DistrictRights: district names, empty = all
- FormRights: screen keys the user can open (empty = dashboard only)
- DEALER login: Username = dealer code · CUSTOMER login: Username = registered mobile

Passwords are stored as scrypt hashes.
Leave Password empty to keep the current one (ignored for iERP administrators — they use their iERP password). Rights fields are only changed when sent.
status: Generated | Printed | Registered | Replaced.

status: Active | Expired | Replaced. Limited to the user's rights (dealer: own sales, customer: own pumps).

`{ warranty }` with installation site (SiteAddress, Village, District, StateId, Pincode), customer, dealer, model and ServiceCallLines (count of service call lines on the serial). Limited to the user's rights.

Active Warranty List edit (prototype rules). SUPER / HO / DEALER only (dealers: own warranties; their dealer is kept).
Customer & site update the customer and the installation. StartDate may be changed by HO and dealers; WarrantyMonths (1-120), ExtendedMonths (0-60) and Status (Active | Void) only by HO — a Replaced warranty keeps its status.
A changed start date or period recalculates EndDate = start + months + extended. Returns { warranty: { WarrantyNo, SerialNo, EndDate, recalculated } }.

For a wrong registration. SUPER / HO / DEALER (own) only.
Blocked when the serial has service call lines (delete the calls or set Status = Void) or when a replacement moved it (delete the replacement).
The sticker goes back to Printed; the installation is removed when it has no other warranty and no service call. Returns { WarrantyNo, SerialNo, installationRemoved }.

Digital warranty card data: `{ installation, warranties }` — customer, site, dealer, borewell / head / array and every component warranty (pump, motor, controller) of the installation. Limited to the user's rights.

Register-warranty form: type the mobile → `{ found, customer: { CustomerId, CustomerName, Mobile, Email, Language, Address, Village, District, StateId, Pincode } }`. Needs the Register Installation right only; `found: false` for a new customer or one outside the user's rights.

Creates / reuses the customer (by mobile), the installation and one warranty per component in one transaction.

**Required** (same as the form): mobile (10 digits), customerName, siteAddress, stateId, district, pincode (6 digits), installDate (warranty starts from it), at least one component. Optional: language (EN | HI | GU, default EN), email, invoiceNo, invoiceDate, dealerId, borewellDepthM, dynamicHeadM, panelKwp, projectId.

**consent** (default true): the customer agrees to warranty updates — a WhatsApp / SMS message with the serials and warranty end dates is queued (see the message log). Existing customers (same mobile) are reused; their email / language are updated.

Pre-fill the form from **Lookup customer for registration**.

**components** — one or more product serials, any mix of pump / motor / controller (none is mandatory). Only `serialNo` is needed: `category`, `productModelId` and `warrantyMonths` default to the serial's sticker and its product model's warranty period. Check serials first with **Serials — list** (`search`) — a serial should be in the Serial Register and not yet Registered.

Dealer logins are always recorded under their own dealer; customer logins under their own account.

request.description: status: Approved | Pending | Blocked.
Send only the fields to change.
Head office only. decision: Approved | Blocked (a reason in `remarks` is required to block). Records ApprovedBy / ApprovedOn. A blocked dealer cannot sign in or register warranties.
Includes InstallationCount, ActiveWarrantyCount, ComplaintCount.
`{ customer, installations, warranties, complaints }`.
Omit / empty CustomerId to create. Language: EN | HI | GU. Mobile must be unique.

exec: if (pm.response.code < 300 && j.customer && j.customer.CustomerId) pm.collectionVariables.set("customerId", j.customer && j.customer.CustomerId);

request.description: Head office only; blocked when the customer has installations, warranties or calls.

Live check for the in-warranty replacement form → `{ old: { ok, message }, new: { ok, message }, canReplace }`.

Old serial must be registered and in warranty (dealers: their own sales only); new serial must be a free sticker (Generated / Printed) of the same component type. A different HP rating is reported as a warning in the message.
kind `old`: serials in warranty the user may replace · kind `new`: free stickers (optionally of one `category`). Returns `{ serials[{ SerialNo, Category, ModelName, CustomerName }] }` (max 30).

Creates the replacement (`REP/<fy>/NNNN`, source Dealer) and moves the balance warranty from the old to the new serial. Returns `{ replacement: { ReplacementId, ReplNo, DaysLeft }, message }`. Checks are re-run on the server.
Replacements done through the flow: ReplNo, ReplDate, OldSerialNo, NewSerialNo, Category, CustomerName, DealerName, WarrantyDaysLeft, Reason. Limited to the user's rights.
Returns the warranty to the old serial and frees the new sticker. Blocked once the new serial has service calls; dealers can only undo their own.

`status`: unknown (not in the sticker register) · unregistered · registered.

Registered → `warranty { State active | expiring | expired | replaced, Label, DaysLeft, ElapsedPct, StartDate, EndDate }`, `model`, and — only when the unit is inside the user's rights (`visible: true`) — `owner` (customer, site, dealer, installation), `components` (the set's other serials) and `history` (registration, service calls, replacements). Otherwise just the status.

`states[{ StateId, StateName, ShortName, Sets, Warranties, ActiveWarranties, Customers, Dealers, Calls }]`. Pass `stateId` to also get `districts[{ District, Sets, Customers }]`. Limited to the user's rights.

status: New | Assigned | Visited | In Approval | Approved | Resolved | Closed | Cancelled. Each row includes DueDate, WarrantyStatus, Components (e.g. "PUMP 2512PU30003, MOTOR 2512MO30003") and PhotoCount. Engineers get only their own calls; dealers / customers only theirs.

Step 2 of the call form: type the mobile → an existing customer loads automatically.

Returns `{ found, customer, installations[{ InstallationId, InstallNo, SiteAddress, Village, District, StateId, Pincode, DealerId, DealerName, ProjectId, Serials[{ SerialNo, Category, ModelName, EndDate, Status }] }] }`. Pre-fill the site from the latest installation and its serials as components. `found: false` → new customer.

exec: if (pm.response.code < 300 && j.customer && j.customer.CustomerId) pm.collectionVariables.set("customerId", j.customer && j.customer.CustomerId);

request.description:
Step 3: each component serial → `{ serial: { SerialNo, State, Label, Category, ModelName, EndDate, DaysLeft, InstallationId, DealerId, ... } }`.

State: `in` (in warranty) · `out` (expired / replaced) · `unreg` (sticker never registered) · `unk` (not in the sticker register — the call is refused with that serial). Correct the component type to `Category` when they differ.

multipart/form-data with field **file** (MP4, WebM, MOV or 3GP, up to 50 MB). Returns `{ video: { AttachmentId, FileUrl, FileName, FileType, FileSize } }`.
Upload each video first, then send the ids in `videoIds` when saving the service call (complaints/add, complaints/update) or job card (jobcards/save). On edit, `videoIds` = every video to keep (leave out = remove; omit the field = no change). Max 3 videos per record.
Uploads that are not linked by a save within a day are deleted. Play / download a video with GET {{baseUrl}}{FileUrl} (supports Range for seeking).

exec: if (pm.response.code < 300 && j.video && j.video.AttachmentId) pm.collectionVariables.set("videoId", j.video && j.video.AttachmentId);

request.description:
Same sections as the web form:
1. **Call details** — callDate (not in the future), callTypeId*, priority (Low | Medium | High | Urgent), source (Customer | Dealer | Toll Free | WhatsApp | Marketing | HO | Mobile App), projectId, dealerId
2. **Customer & site** — mobile* (10 digits), customerName*, village, address, stateId*, district, pincode (6 digits). Pass customerId / installationId from the lookup when known.
3. **Components** — at least one line with a serial or a fault; category PUMP | MOTOR | CONTROLLER. Serials are checked (unknown serial → 400).
4. **Complaint** — complaintText* ; photos optional: up to 5 JPEG / PNG / WebP data URLs, ≤ 3 MB each (resize to ~1600 px before sending).
5. **Assignment** (staff only) — serviceCenterId, engineerUserId (books the call as Assigned).

The server works out: call number `SC/<fy>/NNNN`, due date = call date + call type valid days, WarrantyStatus (In Warranty | Partial | Out of Warranty | Not Registered), dealer / installation from the serials when not given. Dealer / customer logins are pinned to their own records.

Returns `{ complaint }` incl. ComplaintNo, DueDate, WarrantyStatus, Components[], PhotoCount.

request.description: Not allowed for engineers.
`pendingForMe: true` → only cards waiting for the signed-in approver. Each card has CanAct, LevelPosition, LevelsRequired, PendingRole, WarrantyAmount, CustomerPayable.

`{ jobCard, faults, items, approvals, levels, photos, components }`.

- items: ItemType (Spare | Labour), ItemCode, Particulars, SerialNo, Qty, Rate, GstPct, GstAmount, Amount, IsWarranty
- jobCard: SparesTotal, LabourTotal, GstTotal, OtherCharges, TotalEstimate, WarrantyAmount, CustomerPayable, ServiceCenterId, EngineerUserId
- photos: [{ AttachmentId, FileUrl }] (open with GET {{baseUrl}} + FileUrl)
- components: the call's components (serial, model, fault reported)

Same sections as the web form:
1. **Header** — ComplaintId*, JobCardDate (not in the future, not before the call), ServiceCenterId* (defaults to the call's), EngineerUserId (engineers: always themselves), Remarks
2. **Faults** — [{ FaultMasterId, Remarks (nature / diagnosis) }]
3. **Lines** — at least one: ItemType Spare (SpareId) or Labour (LabourMasterId); SerialNo = the call component it repairs; Qty (whole number ≥ 1), Rate, GstPct (0–100), IsWarranty (company bears the line incl. GST)
4. **Photos — mandatory**: at least one photo per job card, up to 10 (JPEG / PNG / WebP data URLs ≤ 3 MB; resize to ~1600 px). On edit, existing photos count; remove some with removePhotoIds.
- **Summary** — OtherCharges (transport etc.).

Server works out: SparesTotal, LabourTotal, GstTotal, TotalEstimate = spares + labour + GST + other, WarrantyAmount (warranty lines incl. GST, capped at total), CustomerPayable. `submit: true` sends it for approval (levels by amount). Only spare lines move stock on final approval.

Older clients sending `items` + `LabourTotal` still work.

request.description: action: Submit | Approved | Rejected (remarks required to reject). The final approval posts stock consumption (engineer van first, then store) and queues a WhatsApp message to the customer.
Only an Approved card. `resolveCall: true` also marks the call Resolved.
Draft / Rejected by anyone; other states head office only (stock postings are reversed).
status: Open | Received | Closed | Cancelled · source: Dealer | Service.
`{ replacement, lines, documents }` — documents are the attached PDFs (open FileUrl with the same auth). replacement.OutOfWarranty = 1 for voucher type Without Serial No.

Each line with old + new serial moves the remaining warranty to the new serial (old must be in warranty; new must be an unregistered sticker of the same category). ReplacementType: Invoice | Delivery Challan | Credit Note.
VoucherType: With Serial No | Without Serial No. 'Without Serial No' = OUT OF WARRANTY: serials are ignored, no warranty is checked or transferred (lines only need Category, Qty, NetValue, Charges). The voucher type cannot be changed after the first save.
PDF attachment is MANDATORY: documents = [{ fileName, dataUrl: 'data:application/pdf;base64,...' }] (max 5 files, 5 MB each, must be a real PDF). On edit, at least one PDF must remain after removeDocumentIds (attachment ids from the detail call) plus new documents.

request.description: Reverses the warranty transfer. Head office / managers only.
Per location (SC = store, ENG = engineer van) and spare: Good, Damaged (faulty held), Value, BelowMin. Engineers see their own van. Engineer-wise Stock screen = this call with locType "ENG".

Spares consumed on approved job cards: date, job card, customer, spare, component serial, consumed-from (engineer/store), qty, rate, value, warranty vs chargeable. fromDate/toDate optional; follows the user's rights.
